# claude-md-generator

> Zero-dependency Node CLI that scans a repository and drafts a CLAUDE.md (the instructions file coding agents read every session): stack, commands, layout, env vars and conventions filled in from the repo; invariants and "where things go" scaffolded as TODOs for the author.

Run in any repo, no install: `npx claude-md-generator`. Node 18+. Reads files only — never executes project code, never uses the network. Never overwrites an existing CLAUDE.md (writes CLAUDE.generated.md instead unless `--force`).

## Usage

- `npx claude-md-generator` — write ./CLAUDE.md
- `npx claude-md-generator <dir>` — scan another directory
- `npx claude-md-generator --print` — stdout only
- `npx claude-md-generator --json` — the raw scan result
- `npx claude-md-generator --agents` — also write AGENTS.md pointing at CLAUDE.md
- `npx claude-md-generator --force` / `--out <file>`

## Detects

TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust; 20+ frameworks (Next.js, Vite, Expo, SvelteKit, Astro, NestJS, FastAPI, Django…); ~80 libraries (Convex, Prisma, Supabase, Clerk, Stripe, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query, Zod, Anthropic/OpenAI SDKs, viem…); env vars from .env.example and from process.env / import.meta.env / os.environ in source; CI and deploy config.
